requirements.title: DIGITS result value is q for integer X and p for real X
requirements.definition: The DIGITS result has value q for integer X and p for real X, where q and p are defined in 16.4 for the model representing numbers of the same type and kind as X.
requirements.oracle:
DIGITS returns exact model parameters for the executing processor, but most numeric values are processor dependent across kinds. Pending plans therefore assert model consistency and source-mandated kind/rank behavior, not a universal precision for every processor.
